sections.title: What transfers and what stays behind
sections.body: Moving from an established accounting system requires planning. You can export your customer lists, supplier details, and inventory items from Sage and import them into Paper & Pen. However, historical transactions and past invoices do not transfer automatically. You must bring over your open invoices and enter your trial balance as opening balances. The most sensible time to switch is at your financial year end or the start of a new tax quarter. This provides a clean cutover point and avoids running two parallel systems for long periods.
items: Export and import customer and supplier lists
Transfer inventory items and current stock levels
Enter open invoices and opening ledger balances
Keep your old system for historical records

sections.title: What you gain when you switch
sections.body: Paper & Pen provides a free forever core product for sales and invoicing. You can create quotations, track leads, issue invoices, and manage receipts without monthly fees. Your team can work in English, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, or Urdu, making it accessible for diverse workforces. We also offer paid modules for HR, payroll, and manufacturing if your business needs them later. You get standard double-entry accounting, configurable tax rates, and inventory tracking in a single cloud system.
items: Free forever sales and invoicing features
Five interface languages including right-to-left support
Standard double-entry accounting and financial reports
Optional paid modules for HR and manufacturing

sections.title: Who should not move to Paper & Pen
sections.body: Sage offers a wide product family with specific industry solutions. If you rely on a specialised Sage industry product, moving to a general cloud ERP might disrupt your operations. Businesses heavily integrated into Sage payroll services also face high switching costs. Furthermore, Paper & Pen does not offer automatic bank feeds or third-party app marketplaces. If your daily workflow depends on direct bank imports or specific integrations, you should stay where you are. Please check Sage's own website for their current plans, pricing, and feature updates.
items: Businesses using specialised Sage industry products
Companies heavily reliant on Sage payroll services
Teams requiring automatic bank feeds and imports
Users who need third-party app marketplaces

faqs.q: Can I import my historical data from Sage?
faqs.a: You can easily import your master data, such as customer contacts, supplier details, and inventory item lists. However, historical transactions, past invoices, and old journal entries do not import directly. You will need to enter your opening balances and any unpaid open invoices manually. We recommend keeping a read-only backup of your old system for historical reference.

faqs.q: When is the best time to switch accounting software?
faqs.a: The most practical time to migrate is at the end of your financial year. This allows you to close your books in Sage and start fresh with opening balances in Paper & Pen. If you cannot wait for the year end, the start of a new tax quarter is the next best option. A clean cutover reduces the need to duplicate data entry.

faqs.q: Is Paper & Pen really free for invoicing?
faqs.a: Yes, our core sales and invoicing features are entirely free. You can create and send estimates, quotations, invoices, and receipts without a subscription. You can also track inventory and manage your general ledger at no cost. We generate revenue through optional paid modules, such as HR, payroll, and manufacturing, which you only buy if you need them.

Paper & Pen offers a free core product for invoicing and accounting, with paid add-ons for advanced modules like manufacturing and HR. Because Sage operates a wide range of products with varying subscription tiers, we cannot provide a direct price comparison. We recommend visiting the official Sage website to review their current pricing and plan limits for your specific region.
